Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 26 · NFL Week 7 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 26, 4:56 PM ET

Dak Prescott has the highest SPAGS projection in the Cowboys at Eagles DraftKings Showdown: 18.4 points at $10,400 FLEX, 27.6 at captain for $15,600. Across 100,000 simulations Prescott holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Prescott is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 6.3 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary, in a game with a 44.5-point total.

CeeDee Lamb has the largest captain share: 15.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Lamb at captain. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 36.2 routes. Dak Prescott is the next captain in line, at 13.9%.

Dallas is a 4.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.5 for the Cowboys and 20 for the Eagles.

Behind Prescott and Lamb, the next projections are Javonte Williams (16.1, $10,600), Tanner McKee (14.6, $8,600) and Saquon Barkley (14.0, $9,600).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 26, 4:56 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

CeeDee Lamb holds 15.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 17.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 36.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Lamb averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.7 and a ceiling of 42.4. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.0% as the captain and 38.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Dak Prescott, DAL QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Dak Prescott holds 13.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 18.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Prescott averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 36.8. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.9% as the captain and 57.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Javonte Williams, DAL RB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Javonte Williams holds 12.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 16.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 16.9 carries and 2.7 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Williams averaged 16.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 33.7. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.4% as the captain and 40.5% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Cooper averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 1.0 and a ceiling of 20.1. He holds 33% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.0% as the captain and 29.9% in a FLEX spot.

Who is the best captain for the Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 15.0%, ahead of Dak Prescott (13.9%) and Javonte Williams (12.4%), across 100,000 simulations.

Build around CeeDee Lamb at captain with Dak Prescott, Tanner McKee and Dallas Goedert at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (250 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Dak Prescott leads the SPAGS model at 18.4 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 27.6 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Cowboys vs Eagles Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 26 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Darius Cooper (8.3 points at $3,200), Makai Lemon (9.1 points at $3,800) and Ryan Flournoy (8.9 points at $5,000).

The Cowboys are a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 24.5 for the Cowboys and 20 for the Eagles.
